create.title: What would you like to create?

lists.title: My lists
lists.name: Name
lists.eventDateClear: Leave empty to remove the date.
lists.reminderLate: Too late for a reminder: it would have gone out at 6 pm the day before.
lists.reminderInvalid: Unreadable date, no reminder will be scheduled.
lists.reminderWeb: Reminders only arrive on the installed app. In a browser the date still shows, but no notification will be sent.
lists.reminderDenied: Notifications declined: the date is saved, but no reminder will be sent. You can allow them again in your phone settings.
lists.reminderBody: Some items are still to buy before {date}.

profile.title: Profile
profile.fontNote: “System” uses the font set on your device.
profile.handHint: The add button sits on your thumb’s side. Independent of reading direction.
profile.previewNote: Preview at the real size of an item in a list.
profile.avatarHint: Without a photo, your initials show on your colour.
profile.avatarTooBig: That image is too heavy. Pick a smaller one.
profile.avatarFailed: That image could not be read.
profile.soundHint: A short beep when you tick, add or scan an item.
profile.hapticsHint: Haptic feedback on phones, when the device allows it.
profile.nearbyCardsHint: As you get close to a saved shop, a notification offers its loyalty card. Once per shop per day, and only if a card is attached to it.
profile.nearbyCardsWeb: Installed app only: a browser does not follow your position once it is closed.
profile.nearbyCardsDenied: Location declined: no card will be offered. You can allow it again in your phone settings.
profile.tourHint: Replay the guided tour of the main screens.
profile.householdHint: Invite your family and share your lists.
profile.adminHint: Approve new accounts and manage roles.
profile.name: Display name
profile.nameHint: This is the name your household sees.
profile.nameFailed: That name could not be saved. Try again in a moment.

scan.stillSearching: Nothing yet? Take a photo of the card and it will be read from the image.
scan.givenUp: No code detected. Take a photo of the card, or type the code in by hand.
scan.failed: Cannot scan: allow the camera, or type the code in by hand.
scan.noCodeInImage: No code found in that image.
scan.imageFailed: That image could not be read.

cards.title: Cards
cards.secretNotice: Loyalty account passwords are never stored here.
cards.tapHint: Tap a card to show it full screen at the till.
cards.nearbyBody: Your {card} card is ready, tap to open it.
cards.attachHint: A chain card works in every shop of that chain.
cards.name: Card name
cards.formatInvalid: This code is not a valid {format}.
cards.brightnessHint: Turn the screen brightness up so it scans easily.
cards.invalidCode: Unreadable code: it cannot be reproduced faithfully.

common.crashed: This screen could not be displayed. The problem has been logged.

list.routeLearned: Sorted to match your route through this shop. Move the aisles to adjust it.
list.routeDefault: Default order. Move the aisles to teach your route through this shop.
list.empty: Nothing to show with these filters.
list.noItems: This list is empty. Add your first item.
list.priorityOnlyHint: Only the items marked as not to be forgotten.
list.hideCheckedHint: Hide what is already in the trolley.

share.title: Who can see this list?
share.note: Only the people ticked here see the list, its items and its chat.
share.circleHint: This list is personal. Sharing it means choosing the circle it will belong to.
share.alone: You are on your own in this circle for now.
share.sendCopied: List copied, paste it wherever you like.

shops.title: Shops and aisles
shops.name: Shop name
shops.addressHint: The town is used to build the initials.
shops.geoDenied: Position unavailable. Allow location access, then try again.
shops.geoUnavailable: This device does not provide a position.
shops.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? The route learned in this shop will be lost.

prices.title: Price history
prices.intro: The latest price recorded at each shop, cheapest first.
prices.empty: No price recorded yet. Tick an item while shopping to note its price.

import.title: Import from a link
import.privacy: The address is sent to this instance’s server, which fetches the page for you and identifies itself to the site visited. Nothing is kept, and no other page is opened.
import.review: Recipe retrieved. Read it over before saving: any line that could not be split came back as written.
import.social: Instagram and TikTok publish no readable recipe: their links cannot be imported.

error.credentials: This address carries credentials: it is refused.
error.port: This address targets a specific port: it is refused.
error.private_host: This address points to a private network: it is refused.
error.unreachable: The page could not be fetched. Try again later.
error.not_html: This link does not lead to a web page.
error.too_large: This page is too heavy to read.
error.no_recipe: No readable recipe on this page. The site must publish its recipe as structured data.

recipes.title: Recipes
recipes.intro: Your household’s recipes, and the shopping list that comes out of them.
recipes.empty: No recipes yet. Write one and its ingredients will become a list.
recipes.name: Recipe name
recipes.servingsHint: The number of people the quantities are written for.
recipes.ingredientsHint: One ingredient per row. Empty rows are ignored.
recipes.stepsHint: One step per row, in the order you cook them.
recipes.peopleHint: Quantities are written for {servings}. They will be scaled.
recipes.deleteConfirm: Delete {name}? Lists already generated will not change.

aisles.title: Aisles
aisles.name: Aisle name
aisles.hint: A new aisle is appended to every route — move it into place from the list.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.signInBody: Pick your lists back up, and your household's.
auth.signUpBody: It only takes a moment, and your settings come with you.
auth.mode: Sign in or create an account
auth.approvalNotice: Your account will need to be approved before you can use the app.
auth.signedUpBody: Check your inbox if a confirmation is requested, then sign in. Access opens once your account is approved.
auth.pendingBody: Your request has been recorded. Access opens once your account is approved.
auth.codeSent: A code is on its way to {email}.
auth.codeHint: Six digits. The email also holds a link, which works just as well.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.sizeBody: Nothing is final — you can change this any time in your profile.
welcome.sizeHint: Slide right to make it bigger.
welcome.lookBody: The screen changes right away. Keep whatever reads best.
welcome.accountBody: Your settings will follow you to your other devices.
welcome.langBody: Every language is written in its own script: look for yours.

tour.createBody: A list, an item, a shop, an aisle, a card: it all starts here.
tour.shopsBody: Order the aisles the way you actually walk them.
tour.magnifierBody: Read a label that is too small, using the camera.
tour.cardsBody: Loyalty cards, ready to show at the till.
tour.profileBody: Text size, colours, language, sharing with your family: it is all set here.
tour.listRouteBody: Take an aisle by its handle and move it: the app remembers the route you walk in this shop.
tour.listFiltersBody: Show only what matters, or hide what is already in the trolley. The dot means a filter is on.
tour.listShareBody: Send the list as it is to someone who does not have the app.
tour.listChatBody: A question asked from the aisle gets its answer here, without leaving the list.
tour.shopsAislesBody: Describe this shop's aisles once and your lists will sort themselves into them.
tour.cardsScanBody: With the camera, or from an image already on your device.
tour.magnifierZoomBody: Slide to enlarge the label as much as you need.
tour.magnifierFreezeBody: A still image reads better than a shaking hand. Tap again to resume.
tour.profileHouseholdBody: Invite the people you live with: your lists and shops become theirs too.
tour.chatBody: Every list has one: agree on a date, share out who brings what.

admin.title: Account approval
admin.demoReset: The demo household is back to its starting state.
admin.demoHint: The demo account is open to everyone. Reset it once it has been used a lot.
admin.crashesEmpty: No crashes in the last thirty days.
admin.crashesHint: Errors collected automatically, stripped of anything that could point to someone and kept for thirty days. The names of affected people are not recorded.
admin.mfaReset: The second factor has been removed. This account now signs in with its password alone, then re-enables 2FA from a device it still has.
admin.errorDenied: This account does not have the administrator role.
admin.errorSecondFactor: Your session stopped at the password. Finish the two-step verification to act here.

instance.title: Instance settings
instance.hint: What this instance needs to know in order to talk to the outside world. None of this is visible to other accounts.
instance.mailIdle: No sending is configured. Sign-ups and reports do pile up, but no email goes out: nobody is notified while these fields are empty.
instance.trackerHint: Lets you open a public issue from a report. The token only needs permission to write issues on this one repository.
instance.secretSet: Saved on {date}. Leave empty to keep it, or type a new value to replace it. It can no longer be shown.
instance.secretUnset: Nothing saved. The value will be encrypted and can never be read back from this screen.

help.mail_smtp_host: The server name given to you by your sending provider.
help.mail_smtp_port: 587 in most cases, 465 for a connection encrypted from the start.
help.mail_smtp_user: Often your address, sometimes the word “apikey”. Leave empty if the relay asks for none.
help.mail_from: The address that will appear as the sender. Your provider must have verified it.
help.issue_tracker_api: Only change this for a self-hosted forge.

mailTest.sent: Message on its way. Check your inbox, and your spam folder if it isn’t there.
mailTest.not_configured: Nothing is configured: fill in at least the sending server and the sender address.
mailTest.auth_refused: The server refused the username or the password. Check them with your provider; many require a dedicated key rather than your account password.
mailTest.unreachable: The server did not answer. Check its name and port; some hosts block outgoing mail ports.
mailTest.sender_rejected: Connection and password accepted, but the provider refused the sender address: you must first get it verified from their dashboard. This is the most common cause.
mailTest.quota: Today’s sending cap has been reached. Try again tomorrow.
mailTest.failed: Sending failed for no recognised reason. The details are in the function logs.

sync.offline: Offline — your changes will sync when the network is back

chat.title: Chat
chat.question: Question
chat.questionPlaceholder: What are we eating on Sunday?
chat.pollNoChoices: Write at least one choice, one per line.
chat.indexEmpty: No lists yet — create one to start a conversation.

household.title: My household
household.circlesHint: One circle is shown at a time: it decides which lists, shops and cards you see. Your personal lists follow you everywhere.
household.inviteHint: Create a code and give it to them. They type it into their own app.
household.joinHint: Enter the code you were given. You will join that circle without leaving your own.
household.errorCode: This code is invalid or has expired. Ask the person inviting you for a new one.
household.errorSecondFactor: Enter your two-step verification code first.
household.errorNotApproved: Your account has not been approved yet.
household.errorLeaveFirst: Your current household has shopping or cards in it. Empty it, or get invited from another account.
household.errorLastMember: You are alone in this household: leaving would make it unreachable.
household.errorTooManyAttempts: Too many codes tried. Wait about fifteen minutes before trying again.
household.errorUnknown: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

magnifier.title: Magnifier
magnifier.denied: Camera access denied. Allow it in your settings to read a label up close.
magnifier.unsupported: The camera is not available here. The magnifier works on your phone.
magnifier.hint: Move closer to the label, then freeze the image to read at your own pace.
magnifier.gestures: Pinch with two fingers to enlarge, drag one finger to move around the picture.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.body: Open your authenticator app and copy the code it shows.
mfa.wrong: That code does not match. The previous one may have expired.
mfa.lost: I no longer have my phone
mfa.backupBody: A backup code removes two-step verification from the account. You will set it up again from a device you still have.
mfa.backupHint: Ten characters, as they were given to you. Dashes and lower case are fine.
mfa.backupWrong: That code matches no unused backup code.

security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Your password, two-step verification, and the devices you are signed in on.
security.passwordBody: The old one is asked for again: without it, a screen left open would be enough to take the account.
security.twoFactorOff: Off. Once on, a code from your app will be asked for at every sign-in.
security.twoFactorPending: Turning on: confirm the code from your app to finish.
security.scan: Photograph this square with your authenticator app.
security.qrAlt: Square to photograph with an authenticator app
security.wrong: That code does not match. Check the time on your phone.
security.backupBody: Ten single-use codes. Each one removes two-step verification if you lose your phone.
security.backupWarning: Write them down now: they will never be shown again.
security.sessionsBody: Close what you do not recognise, or the tablet you lent out.
security.dataBody: A JSON file with everything the app holds about you: your profile, your households, what you wrote. A household appears in full only where you are its sole member — elsewhere, other people’s lists and messages stay theirs.
security.dataError: The file could not be prepared. Try again in a moment.
security.deleteBody: Your account, your profile and your preferences are erased. A household where you are the only member goes with it, lists included. In a shared household, the household stays with the others: your messages remain readable but no longer carry your name, and your votes are removed.
security.deleteWarning: This deletion is final. There is no way back.
security.deleteConfirmLabel: To confirm, type your email address
security.deleteConfirmHint: We ask for it again to be sure this really is you.
security.deleteErrorLastAdmin: You are the only administrator. Appoint someone else before you leave, otherwise nobody will be able to approve new sign-ups.
security.deleteErrorDemo: The demonstration account cannot be deleted.
security.deleteErrorSecondFactor: Confirm your second factor before deleting your account.
security.deleteErrorUnknown: The deletion did not go through. Nothing was erased.

bugReport.errorTooMany: You've sent a lot of reports today. Try again tomorrow.
bugReport.errorTooMuchStorage: You've sent a lot of screenshots today. Try again without one, or tomorrow.
bugReport.errorUnknown: Your report couldn't be sent. Please try again.
bugReport.minimizedHint: Report in progress. Minimised, it lets you see your screen again and take a screenshot.
bugReport.success: Thanks, your report has been sent.

subtitle.bug: Describe what went wrong. A screenshot helps a lot.
subtitle.suggestion: Tell us what would help you, or what you'd like to see. A screenshot helps illustrate your idea.

descriptionPlaceholder.bug: What happened? What did you expect instead?
descriptionPlaceholder.suggestion: What would you like to see? How would it help?

install.title: Familiste on your home screen
install.body: Once installed, the app opens from an icon, without going through the browser, and starts even with no network.

benefit.home: An icon on the home screen, like any other app
benefit.browser: Opens full screen, with no address bar and no tabs
benefit.offline: Starts even with no network: your lists are still there

install.iosShare: Tap the Share button, at the bottom of Safari
install.note: Nothing is downloaded from an app store, and you find your account and your lists exactly as they were.

ai.title: Artificial intelligence
ai.subtitle: Your provider and your key, for recipe ideas.
ai.privacyBody: If you add a key, requests go from your browser straight to the provider you choose. This is the only place in the app where the contents of your shopping leave your device.
ai.privacySent: What is sent: the names of products you have already bought. The exact list is shown to you before every send.
ai.privacyNotSent: What is not sent: quantities, prices, notes, shops, members’ names, and the lists themselves.
ai.privacyBill: The key is yours: your quota and your bill. Nobody else in the household can read it, not even an administrator.
ai.privacyTerms: The provider applies its own terms to what it receives. Read them before adding a key.
ai.stateOn: A key is saved for this account.
ai.stateOff: No key saved. The recipe suggestion does not appear.
ai.providerHint: Only providers reachable from a browser are offered.
ai.keyHint: Only you can read it, and it is never shown again after saving.
ai.keyPlaceholderSet: Paste a new key to replace it
ai.modelHint: Leave it as is if you are not sure which to pick.
ai.suggestTitle: An idea from what you have bought
ai.noProducts: Nothing ticked off yet. Do some shopping, and the ideas will come from there.
ai.willSendHint: Nothing else is sent: no quantities, no prices, no names, no lists.
ai.seeExact: See the exact text that is sent
ai.added: Recipe added to the household’s recipes.

error.network: The request could not be sent. Check your connection, then try again.
error.networkDetail: The request could not be sent: {detail}
error.unreadable: The answer was not usable. Ask again.
